\u0001Purpose

Define the functional requirement for displaying the user's default department/ward in the department/ward selection dropdown of the IP Case Sheet Receive in Department menu when the user is a super user.

"}]},{"key":"scope","title":"Scope","detail":"What is covered","parts":[{"flowId":"00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000","html":"

\u0001Scope

Applies to the inpatient (IP) module where MRD users receive case sheets in departments/wards. Super users have their mapped department/ward pre-selected and can change it; other users select the department/ward manually.

"}]},{"key":"requirements","title":"Functional requirements","detail":"3 rules, 1 requirement","parts":[{"flowId":"00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000","html":"

\u0001Functional requirements

What the solution must do and follow

RuleApplies to
For a super user, the department/ward dropdown defaults to the department/ward assigned in user mapping.Step 2: IP Case Sheet Receive in DepartmentIs the user a super user?
A super user can change the pre-selected department/ward.Super user changes the pre-selected dep...
For users who are not super users, no department/ward is pre-selected and the dropdown works as before.Step 3: IP Case Sheet Receive in DepartmentIs the user a super user?

Requirements

Req. IDRequirement descriptionCategoryPriority
REQ001Default Department/Ward Selection in IP Case Sheet Receive Menu: pre-select the super user's mapped department/ward (changeable); no pre-selection for other users.Change requestHigh

How it will be accepted

REQ001 Given A super user is mapped to a default department/ward, when the user opens the IP Case Sheet Receive in Department menu, then the department/ward dropdown shows the mapped department/ward as selected.
REQ001 Given A super user sees the pre-selected department/ward, when the user selects a different department/ward in the dropdown, then the dropdown accepts and shows the newly selected department/ward.
REQ001 Given A user who is not a super user, when the user opens the IP Case Sheet Receive in Department menu, then no department/ward is pre-selected and the user selects one manually.

\u0001Use case description

Primary actor(s)MRD user
TriggerUser opens the IP Case Sheet Receive in Department menu when a case sheet has come to the department.
Pre-conditions
  • A case sheet has been sent to the department/ward and is awaiting receipt.
  • For super users: the user is mapped to a default department/ward in user mapping.
Post-conditionsThe selected patients' case sheets are received in the chosen department/ward.
PriorityHigh
Main scenarioThe user opens the IP Case Sheet Receive in Department menu. For a super user the mapped department/ward is pre-selected and can be changed; other users select it manually. The user then selects the patients and receives the case sheets.

\u0001How it works, stage by stage

1

Opens the IP Case Sheet Receive in Department menu

MRD user · IP Case Sheet Receive in Department
  • Is the user a super user? - yes → Mapped default department/ward is pre-selected. Continues with: Pre-selects the super user's mapped default department/ward in the dropdown.
  • Is the user a super user? - no → No pre-selection; user selects manually. Continues with: Selects the department/ward manually from the dropdown.
Result: Department/ward dropdown is displayed
2

Pre-selects the super user's mapped default department/ward in the dropdown

System · IP Case Sheet Receive in Department

Uses: Default department/ward from user mapping.

Result: Dropdown shows the mapped department/ward
3

Selects the department/ward manually from the dropdown

MRD user · IP Case Sheet Receive in Department

Uses: Department/ward.

Result: Department/ward selected
4

Selects the patients whose case sheets are to be received

MRD user · IP Case Sheet Receive in Department

Uses: Department/ward.

Result: Selected patient list
5

Receives the selected case sheets

MRD user · IP Case Sheet Receive in Department

Uses: Selected patient list.

Result: Case sheets marked as received
Alternative: Super user changes the pre-selected department/ward. When The super user wants to receive case sheets for a department/ward other than the pre-selected one. Super user selects a different department/ward from the dropdown.

\u0001Assumptions and open points

To confirm with the department

  • If a super user is mapped to multiple wards, which one should be pre-selected?
  • Should the department/ward the user selects be remembered for the session, or reset to the default every time the menu opens?
  • What should the dropdown show when a super user has no default department/ward mapped?
  • Behaviour is not stated when a super user is mapped to more than one department/ward.
  • It is not stated whether the department/ward chosen by the user is remembered for the session or the default is re-applied each time the menu opens.
  • It is not stated what the dropdown shows when a super user has no default department/ward mapped.

content.flowTitle: Default Department/Ward Selection in IP Case Sheet Receive Menu
content.purpose: Define the functional requirement for displaying the user's default department/ward in the department/ward selection dropdown of the IP Case Sheet Receive in Department menu when the user is a super user.
content.scope: Applies to the inpatient (IP) module where MRD users receive case sheets in departments/wards. Super users have their mapped department/ward pre-selected and can change it; other users select the department/ward manually.
content.trigger: User opens the IP Case Sheet Receive in Department menu when a case sheet has come to the department.

preConditions.text: A case sheet has been sent to the department/ward and is awaiting receipt.
For super users: the user is mapped to a default department/ward in user mapping.

postConditions.text: The selected patients' case sheets are received in the chosen department/ward.

steps.action: Opens the IP Case Sheet Receive in Department menu.
steps.screen: IP Case Sheet Receive in Department

steps.action: Pre-selects the super user's mapped default department/ward in the dropdown.
steps.screen: IP Case Sheet Receive in Department

steps.action: Selects the department/ward manually from the dropdown.
steps.screen: IP Case Sheet Receive in Department

steps.action: Selects the patients whose case sheets are to be received.

decisions.condition: Is the user a super user?

alternateFlows.name: Super user changes the pre-selected department/ward
alternateFlows.condition: The super user wants to receive case sheets for a department/ward other than the pre-selected one.
steps: Super user selects a different department/ward from the dropdown.

businessRules.rule: For a super user, the department/ward dropdown defaults to the department/ward assigned in user mapping.
A super user can change the pre-selected department/ward.
For users who are not super users, no department/ward is pre-selected and the dropdown works as before.

screens.menuName: IP Case Sheet Receive in Department

fields.name: Department/Ward
fields.defaultValue: Mapped department/ward for super users; no selection for other users

integrations.description: Supplies the user's super-user status and mapped default department/ward to the IP Case Sheet Receive in Department menu.

requirements.description: Default Department/Ward Selection in IP Case Sheet Receive Menu: pre-select the super user's mapped department/ward (changeable); no pre-selection for other users.

acceptanceCriteria.given: A super user is mapped to a default department/ward
acceptanceCriteria.when: the user opens the IP Case Sheet Receive in Department menu
acceptanceCriteria.then: the department/ward dropdown shows the mapped department/ward as selected

acceptanceCriteria.given: A super user sees the pre-selected department/ward
acceptanceCriteria.when: the user selects a different department/ward in the dropdown
acceptanceCriteria.then: the dropdown accepts and shows the newly selected department/ward

acceptanceCriteria.given: A user who is not a super user
acceptanceCriteria.when: the user opens the IP Case Sheet Receive in Department menu
acceptanceCriteria.then: no department/ward is pre-selected and the user selects one manually

userRoles.menuName: IP Case Sheet Receive in Department

useCase.mainScenario: The user opens the IP Case Sheet Receive in Department menu. For a super user the mapped department/ward is pre-selected and can be changed; other users select it manually. The user then selects the patients and receives the case sheets.

gaps.description: Behaviour is not stated when a super user is mapped to more than one department/ward.
It is not stated whether the department/ward chosen by the user is remembered for the session or the default is re-applied each time the menu opens.
It is not stated what the dropdown shows when a super user has no default department/ward mapped.

clarificationQuestions.question: If a super user is mapped to multiple wards, which one should be pre-selected?
Should the department/ward the user selects be remembered for the session, or reset to the default every time the menu opens?
What should the dropdown show when a super user has no default department/ward mapped?
